name: Hall of Gears
summary: Beyond the Clockwerk Run, the Hall of Gears lies in ruin inside Gnomeregan. Toxic sludge fills its lower floor, while oozes and irradiated troggs roam the chamber.

sections.title: A Fractured Machine
sections.body: The Hall of Gears lies beyond the Clockwerk Run, deep in Gnomeregan’s ruined machinery halls. Its two levels show how completely the gnome capital has fallen. Irradiated troggs claw through collapsed access shafts and prowl the upper catwalks. Below, radioactive pools cover the floor, where corrosive slimes and living poison elementals thrive in the toxic runoff.

sections.title: Pathways through the Waste
sections.body: The Hall of Gears links parts of Gnomeregan’s operational quarters. From the upper walkways, paths lead to contaminated dead ends, the Clean Zone, and the Dormitory. Below, winding maintenance passages lead toward the Launch Bay. Both levels remain dangerous because of the horrors left by Mekgineer Thermaplugg’s venting scheme.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Gears located?
aliases: how to get to hall of gears
faq.answer: The Hall of Gears lies deep inside Gnomeregan, just beyond the Clockwerk Run. Paths from the chamber lead toward the Clean Zone, the Dormitory, and the Launch Bay.

faq.q: Why is the lower level full of radioactive sludge?
faq.answer: When High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered radioactive gas vented to repel the trogg invasion, contaminated runoff collected in the city’s low machinery halls. The lower floor of the Hall of Gears became a toxic wasteland.

aliases: what lives in hall of gears
faq.answer: Irradiated troggs pour through breach tunnels onto the upper level. Below, radioactive fallout slimes, oozes, and volatile poison elementals formed from the industrial runoff.

faq.q: Where do the exits lead from here?
aliases: where to go from hall of gears
faq.answer: The upper walkways lead southwest toward the Clean Zone and the Dormitory, and southeast to a dead-end maintenance corridor. A winding passage west from the lower floor leads to the Launch Bay.

angles.text: As a gnome, seeing the great cogs and catwalks submerged in irradiated sludge recalls the desperate decision that poisoned your city and drove your people into exile.
As an engineer, you can see the scale of pre-fall gnomish gearing and elevated platforms, now heavily corroded by radioactive fallout.
